title: Tobias Stretch's Outdoor Animation
content: Radiohead - Weird FishesfromTobias StretchonVimeo.Tobias Stretch of Philadelphia builds extravagant sculptures of moss-faced people and bird-winged flying machines. Then he takes them outdoors into forests, fields, and city streets to animate them in stop motion. (Link to Vimeo)Tobias Stretch's websiteViaCartoon Brew.
